name: Truce for a Moment
source:
Truce for a Moment is a short dark post-apocalyptic underwater war "huis-clos" with a twist... or maybe two! It features mini-mini-games using numbers, letters and... a French voice!

[From [URL=http://games.renpy.org/game/truce.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/URL]]
translation:
《休战片刻》是一部简短的黑暗后世界末日水下战争“huis-clos”，有一个转折……或者也许有两个！它具有使用数字、字母和……法语语音的迷你游戏！

[从[URL=http://games.renpy.org/game/truce.shtml]Ren'Py游戏列表[/URL]]
